get.description: Which version of Sunfleck and its care data are running, and where the source is.

post.description: Log the same care for several plants at once, e.g. watering a whole room; all or none.

get.description: Whether care profiles can be suggested with AI (an AI plugin is on).

post.description:
Ask the household's AI plugin which built-in care profile fits a plant best, and why.

Sends the plant's name, its species (if known) and whether it grows indoors, with the
list of care profiles. The suggestion is only shown: choosing it is up to the person.

get.description: Every care profile, by name. A short, fixed-size list.

put.description: Change a schedule's mode, interval, or whether it's in use.

delete.description: Go back to Sunfleck's own prediction.

post.description: Match predicted watering to how often the person waters, as suggested.
Don't suggest matching the routine for a while.

put.description: Put off due care until a day (up to two months ahead), or stop putting it off.

get.description: The built-in care types, then the household's own. A short, fixed-size list.

delete.description: Delete a household's own care type. Types that have been used can't be deleted.

get.description:
Download the household's data as a ZIP file: places, plants, photos, care history and
settings. Passwords and secrets (notification addresses, API keys) aren't included.

Report whether the app is running and can reach its database.

Used by Docker health checks and uptime monitors, so it needs no sign-in.

post.description: Create a link that lets a member choose a new password, for when email isn't set up.

get.description: Whether plants can be identified from photos (a plugin for it is on).

post.description:
Identify a plant from 1 to 5 photos of it, through a plugin such as Pl@ntNet.

The photos are sent without their metadata (such as where they were taken) and aren't
kept by Sunfleck.

Import an export into this household, which must have no places, plants or care types
of its own yet. Nothing is imported if anything in the file is wrong.

get.description: Show who invited whom, so the invite page can greet the person. No sign-in needed.

post.description: Create the invited person's account, then sign them in.

get.description: How much light each window (at a typical distance) and grow light gives, by season.

post.description: Set your profile picture: the middle of the photo, as a square.

get.description: The signed-in person's notification channels and preferences.

post.description: Add somewhere to send notifications, as an Apprise URL.

get.description: What today's digest would say, if it were sent now.
A person's profile picture (WebP), for members of their household.
The photo itself (WebP, at most 2048 px on its long edge).
A small version of the photo (WebP, at most 512 px on its long edge).
The household's plants, by name, a page at a time.

parameters.name: needs_routine

schema.description: Only plants that do (or don't) need a care schedule.
schema.title: Needs Routine

post.description:
Add a plant. When it was last watered and fertilized, if known, is recorded as care
(marked as estimated), so its first due dates start from there.

Move plants into a location. Returns the plants that moved (those already there don't).
The lights that reached them are removed, as they belong to their old location.

delete.description: Delete a plant and its photos.

post.description: Log care given to a plant: by default just now, by the signed-in person.

put.description: Choose which photo shows on the plant's card.

get.description:
Is the plant's spot bright enough? Its light in each season compared with what it likes,
and what each window or grow light gives. None if the plant has no location or care
profile, or nothing is known about the light there.
The plant's photos, newest first.

post.description:
Upload a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP, or HEIC, up to 20 MB). It's resized and its metadata,
such as GPS position, is removed. A plant's first photo becomes its cover photo.

`taken_at` is used only if the photo itself doesn't say when it was taken. Without a time
zone, it's taken to be local time at the plant's site.
Add the chosen schedules from the suggested routine, all or none.

get.description:
Schedules we'd suggest for care the plant has no schedule for yet: watering and
fertilizing predicted from its care profile, and a few reminders every few weeks.
The plant's care schedules, each with when it's next due and why.
The plant's care and photos, newest first, a page at a time.

put.description: Turn a plugin on or off for the household, and change its settings.

get.description:
Report whether Sunfleck still needs its first account.

The app calls this before anything else, so it also sets the CSRF cookie that every later
change must send back. (The page itself can't always do that: during development, Vite
serves it instead of Django.)

post.description: Create the first account (an Admin) and its household, then sign in.

get.description: All of the household's sites, with their locations and light sources.

delete.description: Delete a site, with all its locations and light sources.

get.description:
Genera and species by scientific, older, or common name (in any language), best
matches first. At least 2 characters; shorter searches find nothing.
The household's overdue care and care due in the next few days, soonest first.
